class.name: LobbyDirectory
class.brief_description: The peer source for one peer class, backed by a platform's lobbies.

method.name: _accepts_empty_address
method.description: Whether an empty address means something to this provider, so a form accepts a blank field. Defaults to [code]false[/code].

method.name: _address_help
method.description: The sentence a form shows under the address field, telling a player where an address comes from. Defaults to empty.

method.name: _address_label
method.description: What a form calls the address field, such as [code]"Lobby ID"[/code]. Defaults to [code]"Lobby"[/code].

method.name: _address_placeholder
method.description: The greyed sample text a form shows in an empty address field. Defaults to empty.

method.name: _can_host_here
method.description: Whether this build may open a lobby, as opposed to only joining one. Defaults to [code]true[/code].

method.name: _can_probe
method.description: Whether an address can be asked what it is without joining it. Lobby providers usually answer that through [method _list_lobbies] instead, so this defaults to [code]false[/code].

method.name: _capabilities
method.description: The [enum Capability] flags this directory can honor, which is what [method supports] reads. Defaults to none.

method.name: _client_settings
method.description: The settings a join form starts from, which [method _join_lobby] is later handed with the player's edits applied. Defaults to empty. Answer a key here when joining reads it, the way [method _host_settings] answers for hosting. The two overlap by however much the two paths share.

method.name: _display_name
method.description: The provider name a browser shows. Defaults to [method _peer_class].

method.name: _host_lobby
method.description: Creates a lobby, answered through [method deliver] or [method fail] with a connected host [MultiplayerPeer]. [param settings] is [method _host_settings] with the caller's edits applied, so a directory reads only the keys its provider can honor. The advert keys are [code]name[/code], [code]max_players[/code] and [code]visibility[/code], the last a [enum NetwServerInfo.Visibility].

method.name: _host_settings
method.description: The settings a host form starts from, which [method _host_lobby] is later handed with the player's edits applied. Defaults to empty.

method.name: _is_available
method.description: Whether the provider can be used on this build and platform, so a browser greys out what will never work here. Defaults to [code]true[/code].

method.name: _join_address
method.description: The address others join the lobby this directory currently holds by, so a host can show what to share. Empty while it holds no lobby, which is the default.

method.name: _join_lobby
method.description: Joins the lobby named by [param address], answered through [method deliver] or [method fail] with a connected [MultiplayerPeer]. [param address] is one of the strings [method publish_lobbies] published, or whatever a player typed into the field [method _address_label] names.

method.name: _leave_lobby
method.description: Leaves the lobby this directory holds, if any. Idempotent, and reached when a match is torn down rather than when a browse is closed.

method.name: _list_lobbies
method.description: Requests the browse rows, answered through [method publish_lobbies] or [method fail].

method.name: _local_member_name
method.description: The local member's display name. Providers may override this before a Godot peer id exists. Defaults to [method local_member_name_default].

method.name: _member_name
method.description: Resolves [param peer_id] to a display name. Providers with an identity graph override this. Defaults to [method member_name_default].

method.name: _peer_class
method.description: The [MultiplayerPeer] class this directory's lobbies join through, such as [code]&"SteamMultiplayerPeer"[/code]. This is the key a session registers the directory under, so two directories in one session name two classes. Empty by default, which no session adapts.

method.name: deliver
method.description: Reports [param peer] as the answer to the request in flight. The plane hands the peer to whoever asked for it, so a directory neither assigns it nor keeps it alive on the caller's behalf.

method.name: fail
method.description: Reports that the request in flight cannot be answered. [param message] is shown to a player, so it names what the provider refused rather than restating [param error].

method.name: local_member_name_default
method.description: The stock answer for [method _local_member_name]. An override calls this for the case it does not resolve itself, because a script cannot [code]super()[/code] into a virtual the extension declares.

method.name: member_name_default
method.description: The stock answer for [method _member_name], [code]"Player <peer_id>"[/code]. An override calls this for the peers it cannot name itself, because a script cannot [code]super()[/code] into a virtual the extension declares.

method.name: publish_lobbies
method.description: Publishes the browse rows [method _list_lobbies] found. The three arrays are read in step: [param addresses] carries what [method _join_lobby] is later handed, [param names] what a row is labelled with, and [param infos] the [NetwServerInfo] a row is drawn and classified from. A row whose [member NetwServerInfo.app_id] does not match the local build is listed as incompatible rather than dropped, so publish the tag the host advertised rather than the local one.

method.name: supports
method.description: Returns whether [method _capabilities] includes [param capability], which is how a browser hides controls the provider cannot honor.

signal.name: invite_received
signal.description: A platform invite arrived. Only a directory advertising [constant CAPABILITY_INVITES] emits this.

signal.name: lobby_failed
signal.description: Emitted by [method fail] with the reason the request in flight was refused.

signal.name: lobby_list_published
signal.description: Emitted by [method publish_lobbies] with the browse rows a listing found.

signal.name: lobby_peer_ready
signal.description: Emitted by [method deliver] with the peer a host or join request produced.

signal.name: provider_unavailable
signal.description: The provider cannot be used at all, so a browser drops it rather than showing a failing row.
